functions.name: GetMatchState
functions.docs: Returns the current match state, this is an accessor to protect the state machine flow

functions.name: StartMatch
functions.docs: Transition from WaitingToStart to InProgress. You can call this manually, will also get called if ReadyToStartMatch returns true

functions.name: EndMatch
functions.docs: Transition from InProgress to WaitingPostMatch. You can call this manually, will also get called if ReadyToEndMatch returns true

functions.name: RestartGame
functions.docs: Restart the game, by default travel to the current map

functions.name: AbortMatch
functions.docs: Report that a match has failed due to unrecoverable error

functions.name: OnSetMatchState
functions.docs: Implementable event to respond to match state changes

functions.name: ReadyToStartMatch
functions.docs: Returns true if ready to Start Match. Games should override this

functions.name: ReadyToEndMatch
functions.docs: Returns true if ready to End Match. Games should override this

functions.name: Say
functions.docs: Exec command to broadcast a string to all players
